Plan-review round 1 (verified_at_sha e016c152, post-S2-merge) = BLOCK, 6 blocking findings (4 G1G2 scope-completeness, 2 G6 fail-closed). All legitimate — the plan under-scoped from 4 files to ~12. Remediation checklist for the re-plan:

B1 (G1G2): Outbound type-remap consumers are OUTSIDE scope — adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py:143 and adapters/jira_datacenter/backend.py:86 both call _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE.get(ticket_type,'Task'). Add config.effective_type_map(project_key,root) (mirror effective_status_map) and route both create paths through it.

B2 (G1G2): Stamp machinery MISATTRIBUTED. rebar-status: STAMPING lives in outbound_labels.py (_desired_status_annotation/_diff_status_annotation_labels), invoked from outbound_differ.py — NOT inbound_fields.py (which holds only recovery). Add a rebar-type: stamp analog to outbound_labels.py + an outbound_differ.py invocation site; keep only recovery (recover_type_label) in inbound_fields.py.

B3 (G1G2): New rebar-type: prefix must be added to _EXCLUDED_PREFIXES in 5 modules: outbound_labels.py:34, inbound_collection_diffs.py:88, differ.py (mirror comment ~95/468), inbound_translate.py:53, reconcile_check.py:89 — else the label syncs as a user tag / spurious REMOVE mutations.

B4 (G1G2): Per-project skip consumer is outbound_differ.py:374 (_load_config().EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES → _compute_outbound_select_absent_gets, a frozenset with no project dim). Thread project key / resolved skip set; effective excluded set = EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES ∪ {t: type_map[t]==SKIP} keyed by ticket project.

B5 (G6): Fail-closed CANNOT route through S1 validate alone (validate only checks config values vs declared vocab; it has no knowledge of the universe of local rebar types). Specify the mechanism: pass the full set of local rebar types (rebar.types) into the validation step and assert every non-skipped local type resolves to a target.

B6 (G6): 'Never silent drift' is contradicted by create paths coercing unmapped type→'Task' (.get(ticket_type,'Task') at outbound_fields.py:143 + DC backend). Plan must state this default coercion is removed/replaced so runtime cannot silently coerce.

DISCOVERED PREREQUISITE: outbound_differ.py is at 799/800 LOC. B2 (stamp invocation) + B4 (skip threading) both add to it → breach. Filed split ticket f1bc-75f6-ed8c-472f (paranormal-corporeal-illadopsis); a8ea now depends_on it. Do the split FIRST, then re-plan+re-review S3.

compiled_state.description:
# S3 (a8ea): Config-driven type mapping + type-granular skip

## Context / Problem
Epic 3d7a adds a config-driven mapping seam (S1: `mapping_config.MappingLayer` with a
`type_map` axis, `SKIP="skip"`, `resolve_for_project`, `validate`). S2 made STATUS
config-driven — the template: `config.effective_status_map` (`config.py:77`) threads a
per-project `status_map` through the Backend port into the field mappers; `rebar-status:`
stamp in `outbound_labels.py`; reverse-map-free inbound `recover_status_label` (`:152`). TYPE
is hard-coded: `LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA` (`adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py:40` =
`{bug,story,task,epic}`), `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` (`config.py:13`). Distinct types can collapse
to one Jira type (lossy). Syncable = `get_args(TicketType)` (`types.py:23`) −
`EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` = `{bug,epic,story,task}`. S3 is type-only.

## Approach
Three outcomes for `ticket_type`: **remap** (effective type map), **skip** (per-project via
SKIP), **FAIL-CLOSED** on an undecided syncable type. Round-trip safety: NEW `rebar-type:`
annotation label symmetric with `rebar-status:`, reverse-map-free inbound. Type resolution +
fail-closed live in TWO upstream places — the up-front gate and the mapper. acli is UNTOUCHED.

### Finding — acli.create_issue stays a passthrough (NO rewrite)
On the differ path acli NEVER sees a raw local type: the mapper
(`outbound_fields._map_local_to_jira_fields:143`, DC `jira_datacenter/backend.py:86`) already
sets `issuetype` to the mapped Jira NAME, and `dispatch_one.py:188-195` derives
`ticket_data["ticket_type"]` FROM that name. Re-resolving via `LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA` inside acli
would fail-close on EVERY differ create (`"Story"` isn't a key). ALL `client.create_issue`
callers: `dispatch_one.py:209` and `apply_outbound.py:101` pass mapper output;
`access_check.py:150` passes a FIXED probe `{"ticket_type":"task"}` relying on `.capitalize()`.
None pass a config-mappable raw local type, so `acli.py:282` is CORRECT and unchanged.

### Finding 1 (G7) — fail-closed fires ONCE UP-FRONT, before the mutation loop
Parent AC ("load-time fail-closed on undecided types") is PRIMARY. `effective_status_map` is
invoked LAZILY per-ticket in the differ loop, so a per-ticket gate would NOT fire before
mutations. FIX:
- NEW `config.effective_type_map(project_key, root)` mirrors `effective_status_map` (`:77`):
  `builtin=MappingLayer(type_map=LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA)` ← `resolve_for_project`; returns
  `{k:v for k,v in resolved.type_map.items() if v != SKIP}`.
- NEW `config.assert_type_decisions_complete(project_key, root)`: every syncable type
  (`get_args(TicketType) − EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES`) must be DECIDED — target OR `SKIP` — else
  raise `MappingConfigError` (guards a future TicketType; built-in covers all four today).
- WIRING (proves fail-closed-before-mutation): call it ONCE at the top of
  `compute_outbound_mutations` (`outbound_differ.py:298`) — after config load `:377`, BEFORE
  `_compute_outbound_select_absent_gets` (`:381`) and the per-ticket loop (`:430`) — over the
  DISTINCT project keys of `local_tickets` (via `projects_store.resolve_project`). (S1's
  `validate` stays uncalled — S4.)

### Finding 3 (E2) — where the per-project excluded set comes from (SKIP entries)
NEW `config.effective_excluded_sync_types(project_key, root)` = `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` UNION
`{k for k,v in resolved.type_map.items() if v == mapping_config.SKIP}`, over the SAME
`resolve_for_project` layer `effective_type_map` uses. Reuses S1's SKIP sentinel
(`mapping_config.py:51`) as the type-granular skip signal — no separate axis. A local type
mapped to `SKIP` is excluded for that project ON TOP of the built-in set.

### Finding — reverse TYPE map for the lossy-stamp rule (G6)
`_desired_type_annotation` stamps only when the forward target does NOT reverse to this local
type — needs a Jira→local reverse map. `config.py` has none, and `outbound_labels.py` imports
ONLY `config`. FIX: NEW `config.jira_to_local_type` mirroring `jira_to_local_status` (`:64`),
lock-stepped with `inbound_fields._JIRA_TO_LOCAL_TYPE` (`:105`) via a parity test.

### Finding 4 (G1G2) — thread type_map through ALL THREE OutboundMapper impls
`type_map` must follow every one of S2's THREE `map_local_to_remote` bodies + the shared field
mappers, or the differ's `type_map=` kwarg hits a signature lacking it → `TypeError`. Add
`type_map: dict[str,str] | None = None` (beside `status_map`) to: (1) `OutboundMapper` Protocol
(`_backend.py:372`); (2) Cloud `JiraBackend.map_local_to_remote` (`jira/backend.py:73`, forwards
`status_map` `:89`); (3) DC (`jira_datacenter/backend.py:121`) — each forwards into its field
mapper. Then (4) `outbound_fields._map_local_to_jira_fields` (`:101`) resolves issuetype via
`type_map` (replacing coerce `:143`), fail-closed; (5) DC `_map_local_to_dc_fields` (coerce
`:86`) same. NEW `outbound_differ._effective_type_map_for` mirrors `_effective_status_map_for`
(`:272`); `_compute_outbound_create_mutation` (`outbound_mutation_builders.py:37`) passes it.

## Surface-parity census — stamp + inbound + prefix filters
- Stamp: NEW `outbound_labels._REBAR_TYPE_LABEL_PREFIX="rebar-type:"`,
  `_desired_type_annotation` (mirror `:89`, using `config.jira_to_local_type`),
  `_diff_type_annotation_labels` (mirror `:114`). Threaded at BOTH
  `outbound_mutation_builders.py` sites: create `:81`/`:138`; update `:276`/`:281`.
- Inbound: NEW `inbound_fields.recover_type_label` (mirror `recover_status_label` `:152`) +
  `_LOCAL_TYPE_VOCAB` from `get_args(TicketType)`; wired at `:311-313`, label-over-raw `:326`.
- Per-project excluded set replaces the single `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` read (`:377`) at BOTH
  consumers: `:430` (loop) and `:519` (`_compute_outbound_select_absent_gets`).
- `rebar-type:` added to ALL FOUR prefix tuples: `outbound_labels.py:34` (re-export
  `outbound_differ.py:77`); `inbound_collection_diffs.py:88` (re-export
  `inbound_differ.py:31`; read by `reconcile_check.py:96`); `differ.py:105`
  `_BRIDGE_INTERNAL_LABEL_PREFIXES`; `inbound_translate.py:58` `_BRIDGE_INTERNAL_TAG_PREFIXES`
  (keeps its `imported:` omission).

## Scope
New/changed: `config.py` (effective_type_map, assert_type_decisions_complete,
effective_excluded_sync_types, jira_to_local_type); type_map signature thread through
`_backend.py:372` + all three OutboundMapper impls + both field mappers (Finding 4);
`outbound_labels.py`, `outbound_mutation_builders.py`, `outbound_differ.py`, `inbound_fields.py`,
`inbound_collection_diffs.py`, `differ.py`, `inbound_translate.py` (census).
**acli.py is NOT modified.** All additions small; module-size cap 800 LOC (target 200-500).

## Acceptance Criteria
(`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_type_mapping.py`)
- [x] `test_fail_closed_fires_before_mutation_loop` — undecided syncable type raises
  `MappingConfigError` from `compute_outbound_mutations` before any mutation is built.
- [x] `test_skip_is_a_valid_type_decision` — a `SKIP` type passes the gate, is in
  `effective_excluded_sync_types`, absent from `effective_type_map`.
- [x] `test_effective_type_map_default_equals_builtin` — no `[mapping]` ⇒ built-in; project
  `type_map` remaps.
- [x] `test_effective_excluded_union_builtin_and_skip` — == `EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES` ∪ SKIP keys.
- [x] `test_type_skip_excludes_ticket_both_consumers` — excluded at `:430` AND `:519`.
- [x] `test_type_map_threaded_through_all_three_mappers` — `type_map=` reaches all impls, no
  `TypeError`.
- [x] `test_rebar_type_label_stamped_when_lossy` — collapsing types stamp `rebar-type:` at
  create + update via `config.jira_to_local_type`.
- [x] `test_rebar_type_label_recovered_reverse_map_free` — `recover_type_label` restores it.
- [x] `test_rebar_type_prefix_excluded_all_four_tuples` — filtered by all four tuples.
- [x] `test_jira_to_local_type_parity` — == `inbound_fields._JIRA_TO_LOCAL_TYPE`.
- [x] `test_local_type_vocab_derived_from_ticket_type` — == `get_args(TicketType)`.

Test tier: unit
